facts.text: The project depends on rewrite-clj/rewrite-clj 1.2.54 (or latest stable) for structured parsing and modification of Clojure/EDN source.
A new namespace kschltz.agent.tools.clojure implements a group of Clojure file-editing tools behind the Tool protocol.
The tool group includes clojure/query, clojure/add-require, clojure/remove-def, clojure/rename-symbol, clojure/insert-form, clojure/edit-def, and clojure/format-file.
Every new tool has a Malli input schema and output schema, and its implementation satisfies the kschltz.agent.tool/Tool protocol.
All file writes validate that the edited source can be parsed back into the same rewrite-clj AST structure (round-trip validation) before persisting.
The native-image alias in deps.edn and the build-native script are updated so rewrite-clj and the new namespace are included in the native classpath and compiled.
The native-image build completes without errors after adding rewrite-clj and the new tools.
Unit tests cover each tool operation: add-require, remove-def, rename-symbol, insert-form, edit-def, format-file, and query.
Tests include error cases for malformed source, non-existent symbols, and failed round-trip validation.
